links.comparator_used: Model predictions for all epochs without deferral to an expert (the pipeline's starting point)
links.outcome: Sleep staging accuracy on a clinical dataset of elderly sleep apnea patients
links.effect: Full U-PASS pipeline reached 85% accuracy versus 75% at the starting point. Deferral of uncertain epochs to a sleep expert gave the largest improvement gain.
links.quote: The largest improvement gain is due to the deferral of uncertain epochs to a sleep expert.

design_hint: deferral of uncertain predictions to clinical experts
